findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 51 requests to 12 third-party domains (median of 2 passes).
Of 6.5 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 1.6 MB (25%) came from third-party domains, 680 kB of it from services classified as tracking (15 requests).

5 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: amazon-adsystem.com (Amazon, advertising), doubleclick.net (Google, advertising), doubleverify.com (DoubleVerify, advertising), googlesyndication.com (Google, advertising), the-ozone-project.com (Ozone Project, advertising).
5 cookies were set by third-party domains (26 cookies in total).

With the EasyPrivacy filter list applied (domain rules only, 47296 rules), 39 requests were blocked. The page still made 51 requests to 12 third-party domains, including 5 tracking services in our list.
